zh.hint: 人 walks: the left stroke is longer. 入 steps in: the right stroke is longer. 八's two strokes don't touch.
太 has a dot between the legs; 犬 has its dot at the top right, like a dog's ear.
天: the top line is short and nothing pokes above it. 夫: the vertical pokes through the top.
日 has one line inside, 目 has two. 白 is 日 with a small tick on top.
牛's vertical pokes out on top, like a horn. 午 stops at the top line.
千 starts with a slanting stroke; 干 starts with a flat line.
少 is 小 with one extra sweeping stroke at the bottom: small → fewer.
未: the top line is shorter (the tree hasn't grown yet). 末: the top line is longer (the tip, the end).
土: the bottom line is longer, like the ground. 士: the top line is longer.
己 is open at the top left. In 已 the stroke rises halfway up.
他 has 亻 (person) on the left, 她 has 女 (woman).
哪 adds 口 (mouth): you ask "which?".
马 alone is the horse. 口 (mouth) asks a question: 吗. 女 (woman) is mum: 妈.
们 adds 亻 (person): it makes people plural, like 我们.
儿: two separate strokes. 几: a roof joins them at the top. 九: the strokes cross.
东 ends with two dots at the bottom; 车 has a long vertical straight through.
字 is a child 子 under a roof 宀: what children learn at home.
All three have 讠 (speech). Right side: 兑 in 说, 舌 (tongue) in 话, 吾 in 语.
店 has 广, a roof (a building). 点 has four dots 灬 at the bottom.
Both have 见 (see). 视 has 礻 on the left, 现 has 王.
来 has an extra horizontal line on top.
年 has an extra short stroke and line on the top left.
卖 adds 十 on top: to sell, you have more (十) than you need.
座 puts 坐 under 广 (a roof): a seat in a building.
喝 has 口 (mouth): you drink. 渴 has 氵 (water): you're thirsty for water.
很 has 彳 (step) on the left, 银 has 钅 (metal).
Same right side 青. 讠 speech = please, 氵 water = clear, 忄 heart = feeling.
钅 (metal) = money, 纟 (silk) = thread.
饭 has 饣 (food) on the left.
Both have 人. 认 has 讠 (speech), 队 has 阝 on the left.

ja.hint: 人 walks: the left stroke is longer. 入 steps in: the right stroke is longer. 八's two strokes don't touch.
太 has a dot between the legs; 犬 has its dot at the top right, like a dog's ear.
天: the top line is short and nothing pokes above it. 夫: the vertical pokes through the top.
日 has one line inside, 目 has two. 白 is 日 with a small tick on top.
牛's vertical pokes out on top, like a horn. 午 stops at the top line.
千 starts with a slanting stroke; 干 starts with a flat line.
少 is 小 with one extra sweeping stroke at the bottom.
未: the top line is shorter (the tree hasn't grown yet). 末: the top line is longer (the tip, the end).
土: the bottom line is longer, like the ground. 士: the top line is longer.
本 marks the root with a short line at the bottom. 休 is a person 亻 resting against a tree 木.
右 has 口 underneath, 左 has 工. In 石 the top line doesn't cross the slanting stroke.
Both start with 亻. 体 = 亻 + 本 (with the root line), 休 = 亻 + 木.
北: two people back to back (the left half has a tick). 比: two people side by side, facing the same way.
自 has a short stroke on top (a nose — you point to it for "me").
百 is 白 with a line on top: 一 + 白.
方 has a dot on top; 万 doesn't.
Same right side 寺. 彳 (going) = wait, 扌 (hand) = hold, 牛 (cow) = special.
Same right side 青. 日 sun = clear weather, 忄 heart = feeling, 氵 water = clean.
年 has an extra short stroke and line on the top left.
先 ends in two legs 儿. 生 has three horizontal lines.
次 adds two drops 冫 on the left.
毎 adds a small hat 𠂉 on top of 母.
手: the vertical hooks to the left. 毛: the tail curves off to the right.
今 ends in a bent stroke; 令 ends in a dot and a vertical.
外 is 夕 with 卜 added on the right.
All have 門 (gate). Sun 日 through the gap = between, 口 mouth = question, 耳 ear = hear.
来 has an extra horizontal line on top.
In 由 the vertical pokes out on top, like a sprout.
上 points up from the ground line, 下 hangs down from the top line.
